body:
A private equity-backed fund dedicated to making investments in the semiconductor supply chain has raised €1 billion

The fund, Ardian Semiconductor, is part of the French private equity company Ardian.

It has so far invested €700 million in four companies:

VSORA: a France-based fabless semiconductor company designing next-generation AI inference accelerators for data center applications.

centrotherm: a Germany-based company designing and manufacturing thermal processing equipment for semiconductors, including silicon carbide power devices used in electric vehicles and AI data center power architectures.

Synergie CAD: a France-based firm developing advanced test interface solutions for leading semiconductor companies.

Ion Beam Services (IBS): a France-based semiconductor equipment and services company specialised in ion implantation.

Ardian Semiconductor was formed through a partnership with Silian Partners, a team of semiconductor executives. It has also established strategic partnerships with leading semiconductor research centres including with CEA-Leti, for access to advanced research capabilities and technology roadmaps.
